facts.activity_file: identifying every energy source for a task

control_failures.control_label: identification of every energy source for the task

facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: preventive action - alarm setpoint on P-3223

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control ENERGY_SOURCE_IDENTIFICATION: the identification of every energy source for the task was not in place, and the root cause analysis classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Confirm at the next field verification that the identification of every energy source for the task on P-3223 and PT-3223 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in planning and permitting an isolation, specifically identifying every energy source for a task. P-3223 (slurry transfer pumps) is in service for cyclone feed and tailings transfer. The task proceeded during an intrusive maintenance task while the identification of every energy source for the task was not in place. The pressure energy involved is held as hydraulic accumulator, and the recorded presentation was jet release, stored-energy discharge, rupture.
response.summary: On 25 May 2015 a corrective action on P-3223 and PT-3223 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility was reviewed against the critical safeguard it was raised to restore.
